## Review confidence
Confidence: 85% chance of no missed critical bugs.

Least confident areas:
1. The bitmap compression/decompression logic in Ack::write_to and Ack::from_bytes is complex
2. The MIC failure recovery logic in finalize() has subtle edge cases
3. Multi-window scenarios (window > 0) have less test coverage in the visible tests

- Fragment serialization correctly validates invariants before writing"}
